## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Energy leadership is pronounced while Tech is mixed and Consumer Staples weak; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 = 5/5 Energy), so regime supported by broad sector positivity but concentrated winners.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weakest: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary pressured: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Materials shows signs of fatigue: FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy) — large concentration in one sector.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples and some large-cap tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND. Watch TSLA (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -12.48%) RECOVERY for a possible short-term trend change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive internals: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND offset large-cap softness such as AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND; overall Tech showing internal rotation with pockets of accumulation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Broadly constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND and steady bank participation underpin the sector; Financials are contributing to the market’s positive breadth.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed defensive bid but select weakness: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND contrast with UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION — monitor headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy names and select Financials given concentrated strength in Energy and supportive breadth; reduce exposure to the weakest Consumer Staples and lagging large-cap Tech (AAPL, AMAT) until trend confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt but leadership is narrow so be selective and watch for rotation risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +10.77%) with concentrated leadership; Financials (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%) for steady participation. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.11%) for downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND — weekly close above this month’s high would confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming the 1W range would be required to signal recovery. JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for follow-through on bank-led breadth. MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — watch for earnings/distribution reaction after the big gap.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
MPC (+60): Marathon surges after Q2 results; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) — sentiment confirming price move. AMAT (+60): Analyst/AI pick headline, but AMAT is BELOW TREND (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) — bullish news diverges from price (distribution risk). BA (+70): FAA/tech trial headlines; BA is CORRECTION (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) — news aligns with 1M strength but 1W softness.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-45): Headlines on Medicare Advantage pressure; UNH is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) — sentiment confirming price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with a Value/Cyclical tilt given concentrated Energy leadership but narrow top-performer concentration. MPC, PSX and CVX showing clear strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL and AMAT show notable weakness (BELOW TREND). Key risk: narrow Energy leadership and mixed headlines (AMAT bullish news vs price BELOW TREND) — monitor for rotation or breadth fade.
